svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration of the QUARK Windows companion sending PC and Codex telemetry over USB serial to an ESP32-C3 SuperMini carrier, which drives an off-board SH1106 OLED and reads the mode switch. Red and blue status LEDs and a passive piezo buzzer are shown on the carrier connections.

g.text: companion → device: SYS ~2 s · AI ~60 s

svg.text: MODE SWITCH IS READ BY FIRMWARE · CONNECTION CHIME PLAYS ONCE AFTER THE SELECTED FEED BECOMES STABLE
GREEN CHANNEL UNUSED · CARRIER CONNECTORS: OLED / MODE / PIEZO
